title: Law to require solar-powered crosswalk signals citywide
summary: This bill would require the Department of Transportation to install at least 500 illuminated, solar-powered traffic control devices at crosswalks over five years, at a rate of at least 100 per year. DOT would also have to study how effective these devices are compared to non-illuminated signs and report its findings to the Council Speaker within two years. The law would take effect immediately.
